words.sz: 和东京比，伦敦很小。

words.s: It is our obligation to help.
words.sz: 幫助是我們的義務。

t: 典礼， 仪式；礼节， 礼仪
words.s: Thousands of candles illuminated the church during the ceremony.
words.sz: 数以千计的蜡烛点亮了仪式中的教堂。
words.d: A ceremony is an event that happens on special occasions.

words.s: The hawk caught a mouse.
words.sz: 這隻鷹抓到一隻老鼠。

words.s: The exterior of the nut was hard and woody, but the inside was soft and delicious.
words.d: An exterior is the outside surface of something.

words.s: Tom said the scenery was more beautiful than he thought it would be.
words.sz: 湯姆說，風景比他想像的還要美。

t: 恐吓， 威胁； 胁迫
words.s: Don't try to intimidate me.
words.sz: 别想吓唬我。
words.d: To intimidate means to frighten others.

t: 有效的， 生效的 <；给人深刻印象的； 显著的
words.s: Preventive measures are much more effective than the actual treatment.
words.sz: 预防措施比真正的治疗更有效。
words.d: If something is effective, it works well.

words.s: She went to the gym in order to make her muscles stronger.
words.d: Muscle is a mass of tissue attached to bone that helps you move.

t: 宽宏大量的， 慷慨的
words.s: I don't think that Tom was as generous as he should've been.
words.sz: 我認為湯姆不夠大方。
words.d: A generous person likes to give things to people.

t: 可能， 可能性； 可能的事； 希望
words.s: There's a possibility that you'll have to do that.
words.sz: 你有可能不得不那么做。

words.s: Tom remained a bachelor until his death.
words.sz: 汤姆终身未娶。
words.d: A bachelor is an unmarried man.

words.s: My grandma gave me this necklace.
words.sz: 这条项链是我奶奶送给我的。
words.d: A necklace is a piece of jewelry that people wear around their necks.

t: 口子； 孔；开始， 开端；空缺
words.s: The opening ceremony of the Olympics has already begun.
words.sz: 奥运会已经开幕了。

words.s: The probe is equipped with a microphone.
words.sz: 探头配有麦克风。
words.d: To probe into something means to ask questions to discover facts about it.

words.s: Many people work in industrial towns.
words.sz: 许多人在工业城市工作。

words.s: The chair is stable. Its legs are strong.
words.d: A stable thing will not move, change, or fall over.

words.s: Could I have a pillow and blanket?
words.sz: 給我一個枕頭和毛毯好嗎？

t: 概述， 简述；勾画； 写生； 素描； 绘略图
略图， 草图；梗概， 大意；素描， 速写
words.s: Tom ripped a page out of his sketch book.
words.sz: 汤姆从他的绘画本上撕下了一页。

words.s: He didn't respond to my question.
words.sz: 他沒有回答我的問題。
words.d: To respond is to give an answer to what someone else said.

t: 维修， 保养；维持， 保持

words.s: The incident made everyone feel more embarrassed.
words.sz: 這件事弄得大家都比較尷尬。
words.d: An incident is an event that is usually not pleasant.

t: 丛， 群， 串 <；星团 A
words.s: She held a large cluster of grapes in her hand.
words.d: A cluster of things is a small group of them placed close together.

t: 猎物， 捕获物；受害者
words.s: The lion is stalking its prey.
words.sz: 狮子在跟踪它的猎物。

words.s: We encountered a lot of difficulties on the expedition.
words.sz: 我们在探险的时候遇到了很多困难。
words.d: An expedition is a long trip, usually to a place very far away.

t: 吸收；吸引， 使专心；承受， 忍受
words.s: He used a sponge to absorb the water on the floor.
words.d: To absorb a liquid means to take it inside.

t: 涉及， 关系到；关心， 挂念
words.s: Your problems don't concern me.
words.sz: 你的问题和我没有关系。
words.d: Concern is a feeling of worry.

words.s: The fan helped to circulate cool air through the room.
words.d: To circulate is to spread something around, especially in a circular way.

t: 完整， 完全；正直， 诚实
words.s: The principal had a lot of integrity.
words.d: Integrity is honesty and good morals.

words.s: The doctor asked Mary to refrain from eating fast food as part of her diet.
words.d: To refrain from something is to avoid doing it.

t: 协定， 条约， 公约
有责任的， 有义务的；有…倾向的， 易于…的
words.s: You're liable for the debt.
words.sz: 你有义务还债。
words.d: If something is liable to happen, it is very likely that it will happen.

t: 合并， 并入； 吞没 A
words.s: The storm clouds merged into one large menacing cloud that filled the sky.
words.d: To merge two things is to combine them into one whole thing.

t: 状态， 情况；国， 州
words.s: New York's Empire State Building is now running entirely on wind power.
words.sz: 紐約帝國大廈現在完全依靠風力發電。
words.d: To state something means to say it in a definite way.

words.s: The huge ship pulled into the dock, and the crew unloaded the cargo.
words.d: A dock is an enclosed area where ships go to be loaded, unloaded, and repaired.

words.s: The cargo ship arrived four hours early.
words.sz: 货船早到了四小时。
words.d: Cargo is the items carried by a ship or an airplane.

words.s: Tackling an opponent is Johnny’s favorite element of American football.
words.d: An element of something is a particular part of it.

words.s: He was walking up the hill at a steady pace.
words.sz: 他迈着稳健的步伐登上了山丘。
words.d: The pace of something is the speed at which it happens.

t: 很可能的； 大概的； 有希望的
呼喊， 惊叫； 大声说
words.s: The singer interrupted the applause to exclaim his thanks after his performance.
words.d: To exclaim something is to say it loudly, suddenly, and excitedly.

t: 芭蕾舞； 芭蕾舞剧； 芭蕾舞团 <
谦恭有礼；有礼貌的举止
words.s: Jenna always behaves with great courtesy when people visit her home.
words.d: Courtesy is the excellence of manners or social conduct.

t: 提示； 暗示， 信号
陈规， 旧框框， 固定形式， 老套；铅版
成固定形象， 对…形成固定看法
words.s: There’s a stereotype that pigs are dirty animals. But they are rather clean.
words.d: A stereotype is a general but often incorrect idea about a person or thing.

t: 招收； 登记； 入学
words.s: The students had to enroll in the class one semester in advance.
words.d: To enroll in something is to put one’s name on a list as a member of a group.

t: 招待， 款待；娱乐， 表演文娱节目
公文， 文件， 文献
words.s: This document was actually written by Tom.
words.sz: 這文件其實是湯姆寫的。
words.d: A document is a written text, usually not in the form of a book.

t: 恐惧； 令人惧怕的事物
words.s: I dread the possibility that I will not get into college.
words.d: To dread is to be afraid of something that could, or is going to, happen.

words.s: Remove the battery.
words.sz: 卸下電池。
words.d: A battery is an object placed inside something to supply it with electricity.

words.s: Do you know how many people in the world starve to death every year?
words.sz: 你知不知道全世界每年有多少人饿死呀？
words.d: To starve is to not get enough food for a long period of time.

words.s: She made a bowl out of the clay.
words.d: Clay is a type of heavy, wet soil used to make pots.

t: 促进， 增进 <；提升， 提拔；宣传； 助长
words.s: After two years at the company, she was promoted to manager.
words.d: To promote someone means to raise them to a higher position or rank.

words.s: What's the worst-case scenario?
words.sz: 最坏的情境是什么？

words.s: Marriage is the main cause of divorce.
words.sz: 婚姻是造成離婚的主因。
words.d: Divorce is the process of ending a marriage.

t: 分配； 分布； 配 <；散布
words.s: The teacher distributed crayons and markers to her students.
words.d: To distribute something is to give it to a number of people.

t: 缚上， 系上， 贴上；使依附， 使隶属， 使依恋 <
words.s: You need to attach your photo to the application form.
words.sz: 你必须把你的照片贴在申请书上。
words.d: To attach is to put two things together.

t: 生动的， 形象的；绘画的； 文字的； 图表的 <

words.s: She twisted her ankle while she was doing exercise.
words.sz: 她锻炼时扭伤了脚踝。
words.d: An ankle connects your leg to your foot.

t: 小型考试， 测验； 问答比赛
words.s: We had a history quiz this morning.
words.sz: 我們今天早上有歷史小考。

words.s: The main ingredients in cake are eggs, sugar, and flour.
words.d: An ingredient is something that is part of a food dish.

t: 渴， 口渴；渴望， 热望
words.s: I'm dying of thirst.
words.sz: 我快渴死了。

t: 参与， 参加；分享， 分担
words.s: I don't want to participate in the ceremony.
words.sz: 我不想参加典礼。
words.d: To participate is to be active and do something.

words.s: When we moved in together, we had to consolidate our belongings.
words.d: To consolidate means to join or bring together into one thing.

t: 彩票， 抽彩给奖法；碰运气的事 A
words.s: If I won the lottery, I'd buy a new car.
words.sz: 如果我中了彩票，我会买辆新车。

t: 记者， 报导者；报告人； 通讯员
words.s: The reporter criticized the politician.
words.sz: 記者批評了政治家。

t: 乱推， 挤， 用力推；乱塞， 随意放
words.s: She shoved him out of the way.
words.d: To shove something is to push it with a lot of power.

t: 拷问， 拷打；折磨， 磨难
拷问， 拷打；折磨， 痛苦
words.s: Greg thought that writing the essay was torture.
words.d: Torture is action that causes physical or mental pain.

t: 女主人， 主妇；情妇， 情人 A
祈祷， 祷告； 祷文

words.s: I enjoy reading and creating my own lyric poetry.
words.d: When a poem is considered lyric, it expresses a lot of emotion.

t: 拍； 击掌声； 霹雳声
words.s: After the speech, everyone in the crowd clapped their hands for the speaker.
words.d: To clap means to hit one’s hands together to express pleasure or get attention.

words.s: I like the gray sweater more than the purple one.
words.sz: 比起紫色的毛衣，我更喜歡灰色的毛衣。

t: 从离开， 退出； 辞职 <；停止， 放弃 <
words.s: Tom told Mary that she should quit pretending to be intoxicated.
words.sz: 汤姆告诉玛丽她应该停止假装醉酒。
words.d: To quit something means to stop doing it.

words.s: London was very important for economical and cultural reasons.
words.sz: 倫敦過去因為經濟和文化的緣故，十分重要。

t: 磨光， 擦亮；使优美； 润饰 <
words.s: I got him to polish my shoes.
words.sz: 我要他擦亮我的皮鞋。
words.d: To polish something is to rub it in order to make it shiny.

words.s: The tablecloth is in the cabinet.
words.sz: 桌布在櫥櫃裡。

t: 眼的， 视力的；光学的
流行式样； 风尚， 风气；样子， 方式
words.s: You may think those shoes are in fashion, but they aren't.
words.sz: 你可能認為那些鞋子很時髦,但是他們不是。

t: 保险， 保险费， 保险业
words.s: In case the shipment is delayed, we have special delay insurance.
words.sz: 万一船运迟了，我们有特别的迟到保险。

t: 原理， 原则；主义， 信念
words.s: To maintain principles, it’s vital to watch, listen, and speak carefully.
words.d: A principle is a belief about the correct way to behave.

t: 使惊奇， 使倾倒；使眩目， 耀
耀眼的光；令人眼花缭乱的东西

words.s: He suffered from a serious thigh injury.
words.d: Your thigh is the upper half of your leg.

words.s: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
words.sz: 生产日期在盖子上。

t: 乏味的， 单调的， 冗长的； 使人厌烦的

words.s: The Internet is an invaluable source of information.
words.sz: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。
words.d: A source of something is the place that it comes from.

words.s: There were thousands of participants in this year’s marathon.
words.d: A participant is someone who joins in a social event or competition.

t: 家的， 家庭的 <；本国的；驯养的
words.s: The airline has fifty domestic flights daily.
words.d: Domestic refers to something that happens within a particular country.

t: 怒视， 瞪眼；闪耀， 闪光
怒视， 瞪眼；闪耀， 闪光

words.s: She compiled a list of people who she wanted to attend her birthday party.
words.d: To compile things means to collect a variety of them into a group.

t: 偏见， 偏心， 偏袒
使有偏见， 偏心， 偏袒
words.s: The mothers had a natural bias for their own child’s picture.
words.d: A bias is a person’s likelihood to like one thing more than another thing.

words.s: The engine put unpleasant, black fumes into the air.
words.d: Fumes are unhealthy smoke and gases that are made by fires or chemicals.

words.s: We are traveling on a tight budget.
words.sz: 我們很節省地旅行。
words.d: A budget is the amount of money available to spend on something.

t: 放射， 辐射；散布， 传播
words.s: The heat from the fireplace radiated throughout the room.
words.d: To radiate means to send out energy or heat.

words.s: We often played chess after school.
words.sz: 我們常常在放學後下棋。

t: 映像， 倒影；反省， 沉思
words.s: Tom looked at his reflection in the mirror.
words.sz: 汤姆看他在镜中的映像。
words.d: A reflection is an image that is seen in a mirror or other shiny surface.

words.s: I took him to the most expensive restaurant on campus.
words.sz: 我把他带到校区里最贵的餐馆去了。

t: 最后的， 最终的；根本的， 基本的
words.s: Our ultimate goal is to establish world peace.
words.sz: 我们的究极目标是树立世界和平。
words.d: When something is ultimate, it is the final result or aim of a long series of events.

t: 继续从事；对…提起公诉； 告发， 检举
words.s: They were prosecuted for fishing in the river without a permit.
words.d: To prosecute someone means to take legal action against them.

t: 用言辞的， 用文字的；口头的；动词的
骚扰， 扰乱； 烦恼， 烦乱
地区， 区域； 行政区
words.s: The typhoon struck the Kanto district.
words.sz: 台风袭击了关东地区。
words.d: A district is a small part of a city, county, state, or country.

words.s: Overall, the party was a huge success.
words.d: When a thing is talked about overall, the whole thing is considered.

t: 假装；假定， 设想；采取， 承担， 呈现 <
words.s: Let's assume that'll happen.
words.sz: 讓我們假定那會發生。
words.d: To assume something is to think that it is true, even with no proof.

words.s: I seasoned the fish with salt and pepper.
words.sz: 我在魚上灑鹽和胡椒作調味。

words.s: Everyone ought to be the master of his own destiny.
words.sz: 每個人都應該做自己命運的主人。
words.d: A destiny is all the things that happen or will happen to a person in their life.

t: 记忆， 回忆； 记忆力；存储
words.s: What I hate most of all is having to recite texts from memory.
words.sz: 我最讨厌背诵课文了。
words.d: A memory is something you remember.

t: 概念， 观念； 思想
words.s: I understand the concept.
words.sz: 我明白这概念。
words.d: A concept is an idea about something.

t: 抵抗的， 有抵抗力的

words.s: It sounds as if he were to blame for the disaster.
words.sz: 听起来好像他是这场灾难的罪魁祸首。
words.d: A disaster is a really bad thing that happens.

words.s: Our grocer, Mr. Smith, is a very kind man.
words.d: A grocer is a person who sells food.

words.s: Amy’s blue shirt really enhances the color of her eyes.
words.d: To enhance something is to make it better.

t: 大会， 会议；惯例， 常规， 习俗；公约， 协定
words.s: In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
words.d: A convention is behavior that is considered to be common or polite.

words.s: The police had a suspicion that the driver had stolen the purse.
words.d: A suspicion is a feeling that something is possible or true in a crime.

words.s: You cannot purchase this medicine without a prescription.
words.sz: 那个药的话没有处方是买不到的。

words.s: I interpreted her silence as a refusal.
words.sz: 我認為她的沉默就是表示拒絕。

t: 旁路， 迂回的旁道； 搭桥术； 旁通管

words.s: We all put money into our club’s fund.
words.d: A fund is an amount of money that people have.

t: 重力， 引力；庄重； 严重
words.s: It's gravity that makes satellites move around the Earth.
words.sz: 让卫星环绕地球的是重力。
words.d: Gravity is the force that makes things fall to Earth.

words.s: I was the recipient of four phone calls today.
words.d: A recipient of something is the person who receives it.

t: 共和国， 联邦， 共同体

words.s: The government financed the scientist’s experiments with new weapons.
words.d: To finance someone or something means to provide money for them.

t: 画室；播音室； 制片厂
招致， 惹起； 遭受
管制， 控制 <；调节， 校准；调整
words.s: The bank regulates how much money people can borrow.
words.d: To regulate something is to control how it happens.

words.s: I am interested in palm reading.
words.sz: 我对掌上阅读很感兴趣。

words.s: The premise of the movie that Bobbi and I watched was unrealistic.
words.d: A premise is an idea on which something is based.

words.s: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
words.sz: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
words.d: When you make a payment, you give someone some money for what you get.

t: 引起争论的， 有争议的
words.s: This theory is very controversial.
words.sz: 这个理论很有争议。

words.s: If you want to attain a healthy body, you must exercise every day.
words.d: To attain something is to succeed at something or to get something you want.

t: 长廊， 画廊， 美术馆
words.s: The art gallery displayed beautiful paintings.
words.d: A gallery is a large space where people can see works of art.

t: 承租人； 房客； 佃户
words.s: The new tenants moved into the house across the street.
words.d: A tenant is a person who rents property from a landlord.

t: 五金， 金属制品；硬件

words.s: He will be my deputy while I am away.
words.sz: 我不在的时候，他将是我的代理人。

t: 暖和， 温暖 A；热心， 热情
先， 前；优先， 优先权
words.s: My priority is to get good grades in school.
words.d: A priority is something that is more important than other things.

t: 水湾， 小湾；进口， 入口 A
有创造力的， 创造性的
审判的， 司法的； 法庭的， 法官的；公正的， 明断的
穿梭般来回， 短程穿梭运送
航天飞机；梭子；短程穿梭运行的飞机
分配， 分派； 把…拨给
words.s: The government allocated $100 million to aid the disaster relief effort.
words.d: To allocate something means to put it aside for a certain purpose or person.

t: 最初的， 初级的；首要的， 主要的， 基本的
words.s: This problem is too difficult for primary school children to solve.
words.sz: 这个问题让小学生解决太难了。
words.d: If something is primary, it is the most important thing.

t: 原木， 圆木；航海日志
words.s: In Canada, there are many areas where it is illegal to log trees.
words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。
words.d: A log is a thick piece of wood that is cut from a tree.

t: 事业； 企业单位；事业心， 进取心
words.s: My father owns an advertising enterprise.
words.d: An enterprise is a company or business.

words.s: The nearest star to our solar system is Proxima Centauri.
words.sz: 離我們太陽系最近的恆星是比鄰星。
words.d: If something is solar, it is related to the sun.

t: 消费， 消耗， 耗尽 <
words.s: The Swiss consume a large amount of beer.
words.sz: 瑞士人消耗不少啤酒。
words.d: To consume something means to eat or drink it.

words.s: The formation of ice happens when water freezes.
words.d: A formation is the way that something is made.

words.s: What's the number for the Tokyo Dome?
words.sz: 东京巨蛋的电话号码是多少？
words.d: A dome is a curved roof of a building.

t: 保险丝， 导火线， 引信
words.s: The boy lit the fuse on the rocket and waited for it to burst in the sky.
words.d: A fuse is a string on fireworks that burns to make them explode.

t: 高级的， 优质的；售价高的
保险金；额外费用， 加付款；奖赏； 赠品； 额外津贴
words.s: Tony paid a premium for the gas because it made his car run better.
words.d: A premium is a payment that is higher than average.

words.s: He came to my house on the pretext of seeing me.
words.sz: 他打着见我的幌子来了我家。

t: 使确信， 使放心；保证， 担保
words.s: He assured the boss that the building would be done on time.
words.d: To assure people is to tell them something is true to make them less worried.

words.s: All the citizens came together in a show of solidarity to create change.
words.d: Solidarity is a union formed from common responsibilities or interests.

words.s: I don't know who to consult with.

words.sz: 他这么说就是为了开玩笑。

words.s: The child made an awful fuss because she didn’t want to go to bed.

words.sz: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。

words.sz: 那個地點的書店無法賺足夠的錢生存下去。

words.d: An orphan is a child who does not have parents.

words.sz: 你相信死后永生吗？

words.sz: 汤姆总是说话声音太小，我几乎听不懂他在说什么。
words.d: Barely means by the smallest amount, almost not.

words.s: A mother sloth will cling tightly to her baby in the treetops.
words.d: To cling to something means to hold onto it tightly.

words.s: This book is a satire of what life was like in the army.
words.d: A satire is a work of art that uses humor and irony to make fun of something.

words.s: Growing a beard is more prevalent in some countries than in others.
words.d: When something is prevalent, it is common.

words.sz: 我有糖尿病。

t: 非常宝贵的， 无价的 <

words.sz: 互联网是一种无法估量的信息资源。

t: 紧密的， 结实的；简洁的；紧凑的
words.s: She gave me this compact disc.
words.sz: 她給了我這個光碟。

words.s: The junior executives formed an alliance with each other.
words.d: An alliance is a group of people who work together.

words.s: In dry climates, it is important to irrigate fields of crops.
words.d: To irrigate means to supply water to land so that crops can grow.

words.s: This dam supplies us with water and electricity.
words.sz: 这个水坝给我们提供水和电。

words.d: When one thing denotes another, it stands as a sign or substitute for that thing.

words.sz: 本周公园樱花盛开。
words.d: To bloom is to produce an open flower.

words.s: Firefighters often work in danger zones.
words.d: A zone is an area that has different qualities from the ones around it.

words.d: Majesty is supreme greatness or authority.

words.sz: 融合爵士是搖滾樂與爵士樂的融合。

words.sz: 玛丽通常不戴首饰。

献祭； 献出； 牺牲

words.sz: 为了救许多人牺牲一个人是否道德？

words.sz: 在加拿大有很多區域砍伐樹木是非法的。

words.sz: 您没必要准备一个正式的演讲。

words.d: To congratulate someone is to tell them that you are happy for them.

words.s: Did you see the rainbow this morning?
words.sz: 你见到今天早上的彩虹了吗？

t: 充分的， 富裕的 <；宽敞的， 宽大的

words.sz: 我们有充裕的时间赶上火车。
words.d: If something is ample, then it is enough or more than enough.

words.s: He makes a living as a salesman.
words.sz: 他當推銷員為生。

words.s: The clown entertained the kids at the party.
words.d: To entertain someone is to do something that they enjoy.

t: 减轻， 缓和；使舒适， 使安心
容易， 轻松；舒适， 悠闲

words.sz: 我面对陌生人很不自在。
words.d: Ease is a condition without difficulty or hard work.

words.sz: 搭帳篷花了我們半小時。

words.s: Put your paddle in the water and pull hard to make the boat move.
words.d: A paddle is a piece of wood or plastic that moves a boat across water.

t: 穿过， 渗入；看穿， 洞察
words.s: The knife easily penetrated the surface of the orange.

t: 急速移动；急升， 猛涨

t: 伙伴关系； 友谊； 团体

words.sz: 我是汤姆的一位同事。

words.s: I'm studying economics in college.
words.sz: 我正在大学里读经济。

words.s: The kids showed Aunt Tess much gratitude for visiting them.
words.d: Gratitude is a feeling of being thankful.

words.sz: 我想试试这件。请问哪里是试衣间？

words.sz: 我不能再忍受這個噪音了。

words.sz: 湯姆把一疊信放在瑪麗桌上。

words.sz: 我觉得李斯特的《被遗忘的圆舞曲第三首》是个被埋没的名曲。

words.sz: 美國的司法制度是世界上最好的。

words.sz: 事故發生在高速公路上。

words.sz: 這個包裹上的地址是錯的。

words.sz: 汽车尾气在城镇里造成了严重的污染。

words.sz: 這不是葡萄酒，是葡萄汁。

words.sz: 我告诉汤姆我愿意借给他一些钱。

words.sz: 我才想起来我之前该买个面包。

words.sz: 我們所有的人都想除掉核子武器。

words.sz: 蔬果对平衡饮食必不可少。
words.d: If something is essential, it is very important and necessary.

words.s: Mr. Jones came to fix the furnace.
words.d: A furnace is a place where heat is made.

words.s: When the car slid off of the road, it fell into the ditch.
words.d: A ditch is a narrow hole cut into the ground by a road or a field.

words.s: I didn't mean to scare Tom.
words.sz: 我沒想嚇唬湯姆的。

words.sz: 閃電常常伴隨著雷鳴。
words.d: Thunder is the loud noise heard during a storm.

words.d: To furnish means to put furniture in a house or room.

words.d: A garment is a piece of clothing.

words.d: Criticism is the act of saying that something is not correct or good.

words.d: To enlighten someone is to teach them about something.

words.d: To deduct means to subtract something.

words.d: The image of something is a picture of it.

words.d: To portray something means to describe it or show it in a picture.

words.d: If something is homogeneous, it is made up of things which are all the same.

words.s: The large house had floors made of marble.
words.d: Marble is a type of rock that feels cold and is smooth when cut.

words.sz: 電腦現在是一個絕對必要的東西了。

words.sz: 我住的地方－倫敦，從前以霧聞名。
words.d: Fog is a thick cloud that is near the ground or water.

words.s: I have to get a frame for my friend’s picture.
words.d: A frame is a border for a picture or mirror.

t: 起源， 由来；出身， 来历
嗓音的， 发声的；直言不讳的

words.d: When someone is vocal, he or she expresses a strong opinion publicly.

words.s: The sisters often clash over the right way to do things.
words.d: To clash means to fight or argue over something.

t: 预防； 谨慎； 警惕
words.s: As a precaution, you should put on a heavy coat before going out in cold weather.
words.d: A precaution is an action that is meant to stop something bad from happening.

words.sz: 科学上，血型和性格的关联性没有被证明。

words.sz: 在2015年9月日本的失业率为3.4％。

矛盾， 反对；相反， 反面；对立物， 对立面

words.sz: 玛丽不穷，相反，她相当富裕。

words.d: To contend with something means to struggle to overcome it.

words.s: My cell phone has a built-in digital camera.
words.sz: 我的手機有內建的數位相機。
words.d: When something is digital, it is characterized by computer technology.

words.s: Vick’s band rehearsed all week before their first show.

t: 投机， 冒险； 赌博

words.sz: 人皆有錯，唯聖者能恕。

words.sz: 法國是一個福利國家，但它卻不再能夠負擔得起了。

words.sz: 一个男的突然出现在门口。

words.sz: 我不滿意我的英語能力。

words.sz: 我相信，知识就是力量。

words.sz: 我想買條褲子。

words.sz: 美国是一个自称没有社会阶层的国家。

words.sz: 地震後人們普遍覺得恐慌。

words.sz: 你能告诉我最近的古玩店在哪里吗？

words.sz: 英語是一種溝通的手段。

t: 慢性的；积习难改的；严重的； 坏的

words.d: When something is chronic, it happens over and over again for a long time.

words.s: Fasten your seat belt, please.
words.sz: 請繫好安全帶。
words.d: To fasten something is to close it or attach it to something.

words.sz: 这就是那个作家自杀的房间。

words.sz: 二加三加四的和是九。

words.sz: 我想您要拿到驾照根本不难。

words.d: To gaze at something means to look at it for a long time.

words.sz: 我希望我能知道如何刪除我的Facebook帳號。

words.sz: 現今每個人都對天花免疫了。

words.d: When somebody is stern, they are very serious.

words.sz: 你知道什么是复合词吗？

words.sz: 很难在2、3年内掌握法语。

words.d: To complicate something means to make it harder than necessary.

words.s: Have you worked the puzzle out?
words.sz: 你解开谜团了吗？
words.d: A puzzle is something that is hard to understand.

words.sz: 数据表明年轻人抽烟的现象没有减少。

words.sz: 他为了惹恼我故意犯错。

words.sz: 一些家具是用膠水黏在一起。

无知的， 愚昧的； 不知道的

words.sz: 他们的计划我一无所知。
words.d: If someone is ignorant about something, they have no knowledge about it.

t: 可以忽略的， 微不足道的

words.d: If something is negligible, it is extremely small and not important.

words.sz: 我认为辨别清楚意见和事实很重要。

t: 嗥叫； 呼啸；吼叫； 哀号

words.sz: 今天午餐時間，我們常去的飯館關門了，因為他們家在辦喪事。
words.d: A funeral is a ceremony that takes place after a person dies.

words.s: He told his wife not to buy on impulse.
words.sz: 他叫自己的妻子不要衝動購物。

words.sz: 他不信教。

words.s: He is usually friendly. Nevertheless, he wasn’t friendly this afternoon.
words.d: Nevertheless shows a difference to what is expected or known.

t: 突起的， 凸出的；杰出的， 著名的
words.s: Queen Victoria was a prominent person in history.
words.d: When something is prominent, it is important and well known.

words.s: A diamond is one of the most expensive jewels in the world.
words.d: A jewel is a beautiful stone that is worth a lot of money.

words.s: Needless to say, fundamental human rights should be respected.
words.sz: 無須多言，基本人權應當被尊重。
words.d: If something is fundamental, it is a basic part of something.

words.s: Global warming worries scientists.
words.sz: 全球變暖讓科學家擔心。
words.d: If something is global, it happens all around the world.

t: 给以权利；给…以称号； 给…题名

words.sz: 湯姆告訴我，他以為瑪莉會有耐心。

words.sz: 援救人员为了找到孩子，仔细搜索了那个区域。

t: 谴责， 指责 A；判刑， 宣告有罪

words.sz: 英語在商業中很有用。

words.sz: 離開前我必須刮鬍子。

words.sz: 当我回到家的时候，我妹妹正在弹吉他。

words.sz: 明尼苏达州的官方鸟就是蚊子。

words.sz: 人造皮革是比不上真皮的。

words.sz: 有的科學家認為溫室效應是虛構的。

words.sz: 得不到的东西就最想得到。

words.sz: 一家人在陽臺上吃早飯。

words.sz: 我們因缺乏準備而失敗了。

words.sz: 世界語只有16個語法規則。

t: 使能够， 使成为可能

words.sz: 因为台风的关系，我的父母提早一天结束了旅行回到家。

words.sz: 这个岛的经济依靠的是渔业。

words.sz: 教英语是他的职业。

words.sz: 這拉鍊卡卡的。

words.d: To compress something means to press or squeeze it so that it takes up less space.

t: 出现， 发生；由…引起， 由…产生 A

words.d: To arise is to happen.

t: 想象， 空想； 想象力

words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。

words.sz: 我在擦鞋墊下面發現了這把鑰匙。

words.sz: 你最喜歡的兒童歌曲是哪首？

words.d: The spectrum is the full range of color ranging from red to violet.

words.sz: 公主向皇帝请求饶恕。
words.d: An emperor is the leader of a group of countries.

words.s: Sandy walked slowly across the beach, trying to prolong her lunch break.
words.d: To prolong means to make something last for a longer time.

words.d: A valve is a device attached to a pipe and controls the flow of liquid or air.

t: 特别喜欢的， 中意的
words.s: Tom donates half his salary to his favorite charity.
words.sz: 汤姆捐一半他的薪水给他最喜欢的慈善机构。

t: 退还， 偿还； 退款
words.s: I asked for a refund because the shoes I bought were too tight.
words.d: A refund is money given back to a person when an item is returned to a store.

words.s: We were in great distress when our home was destroyed during the last hurricane.
words.d: Distress is a feeling of sadness and anxiousness.

t: 残余物； 零头布料；遗迹

words.s: My grandmother has a green thumb.
words.sz: 我祖母是個園藝巧手。

words.s: The path zigzagged up the steep slope.
words.sz: 這條小路沿著陡峭的斜坡蜿蜒而上。
words.d: A steep surface or place has a slope or angle that rises or falls sharply.

words.s: I always enjoy listening to classical music when I have some free time.
words.sz: 有空的时候，我总喜欢听古典音乐。
words.d: Classical music is more formal and serious than popular music.

t: 特权， 优惠， 特许
给予优惠， 给予特权
words.s: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
words.sz: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。
words.d: A privilege is a special right given only to a certain person or group of people.

words.s: When I ran out of juice, I had to substitute water to drink in the morning.
words.d: To substitute something or someone means to have them take the place of another.

t: 燃烧， 冒火焰；照耀， 发光
火焰； 火光；闪光， 光辉
words.s: The small fire soon blazed into a large, dangerous one.
words.d: To blaze means to burn brightly or powerfully.

t: 再者， 加之， 而且
words.s: Marianne likes to walk to work to save money; moreover, it is good exercise.
words.d: Moreover is used to introduce information that adds to or supports what has previously been said.

t: 神秘的， 可疑的； 难理解的
words.s: This place has a mysterious atmosphere to it.
words.sz: 这个地方的气氛很神秘。

t: 散开， 驱散；散布， 散播
words.s: I accidentally scattered all of my pills.
words.d: To scatter something is to make it go in many places.

words.s: I was given a ticket because the policeman said I violated a traffic law.
words.d: To violate a law, rule, or agreement means to break it.

words.s: He steered the go-cart around the track.
words.d: To steer something is to control where it goes.

t: 遭受； 经历； 承受
words.s: The cancer patient undergoes treatments twice a week.
words.d: To undergo an action means to have it happen to you.

t: 同情， 体谅； 共鸣， 同感

words.s: The railroad is parallel to the road.
words.sz: 铁路与公路平行。

t: 代理， 代办处； 机构
words.s: We'll need a head hunting agency to find the right man for this executive position.
words.sz: 我們需要人力仲介公司幫我們找到合適的人來擔任這個管理職位。
words.d: An agency is a business or service set up to act for others.

t: 礼券， 优惠券， 配给券；票证

words.s: A multitude of people were waiting at the airport.
words.d: A multitude of things or people is a very large number of them.

words.s: No one inhabits the ancient city.
words.d: To inhabit means to live in a certain place.

words.s: Some abstract art is difficult to understand.
words.sz: 一些抽象藝術是很難理解的。
words.d: An abstract thing is an idea or thought, not a physical thing.

words.s: Let's proceed with the items on the agenda.
words.sz: 讓我們繼續進行議程上的項目。
words.d: An agenda is a plan or goal that guides someone’s behavior.

words.s: Jenny excels at playing the piano.
words.d: To excel at a subject or activity means to be very good at it.

t: 出现， 出场， 露面；外表， 外貌， 外观
words.s: Judging from his appearance, he must be a rich man.
words.sz: 从他的外表来看，他应该是个有钱人。

t: 液体的， 液态的 A
words.s: Water is liquid. When it freezes, it becomes solid.
words.sz: 水是液体。冻起来就成了固体。
words.d: A liquid is a substance that is neither solid nor gas.

t: 匿名的， 无名的；无特色的
words.s: You want to remain anonymous.
words.sz: 你想保持匿名身份。
words.d: If someone is anonymous, no one knows who he or she is.

words.s: I think Tom is going to be pretty mad when he finds out that the painting he bought is a fake.
words.sz: 我觉得当汤姆发现他买来的画是赝品的时候，他会很生气。
words.d: A fake thing is made to look real in order to trick people.

words.s: My father is a skilled fisherman.
words.sz: 我爸爸是个钓鱼高手。

t: 跨度， 跨距； 范围
words.s: The life span of a butterfly is short.
words.sz: 蝴蝶的寿命短。
words.d: To span is to spread across an amount of time or space.

words.s: What a bizarre story!
words.sz: 多么荒唐的故事！
words.d: When something is bizarre, it is very strange.

t: 民意测验；政治选举， 大选
对…进行民意测验；获得…选票
words.s: The poll showed that many people support the plan to stop gang violence.
words.d: A poll is a survey in which people give their opinions about important things.

t: 少数， 少数派； 少数民族

words.s: She is graceful.
words.sz: 她举止优雅。

t: 更可取的， 较适合的， 更好的
提及， 涉及 A；参考； 参考书目；证明书； 介绍
words.s: My supervisor made a reference to the data I’d collected.
words.d: A reference is the act of referring to something or someone.

words.s: The businessman thought there was a conspiracy among his coworkers to get him fired.
words.d: A conspiracy is a secret plan that two or more people make together to do something harmful or illegal.

words.s: The meeting was held in the faculty chamber.
words.d: A chamber is a closed space or room used for a special purpose.

words.s: In spite of the heavy rain, he visited his friend in the hospital.
words.sz: 尽管雨下得很大，但他还是去医院看望他的朋友了。
words.d: Spite is the desire to be mean.

words.s: Eat a live frog every morning, and nothing worse will happen to you the rest of the day.
words.sz: 每天早上吃一隻活青蛙,那麼你一天中其他的時間就不會發生什麼更糟糕的事了。

t: 整理， 排列， 布置 A；安排， 筹备
words.s: I'll arrange for someone to pick you up at your home.
words.sz: 我会安排一下，叫个人去你家接你。
words.d: To arrange things is to put them in the right place.

words.s: My nephew is allergic to eggs.
words.sz: 我侄子對雞蛋過敏。

t: 宣传， 宣扬；公众的注意， 名声
words.s: She received a lot of publicity after her performance in the film.
words.d: Publicity is public attention given to someone or something by the media.

words.s: How often do the buses depart?
words.sz: 公共汽车多久发车一次？
words.d: To depart is to leave some place so you can go to another place.

words.s: He studied archeology to learn more about ancient Egyptian culture.
words.d: Archeology is the study of ancient people through their artifacts.

t: 始终如一的， 不变的； 恒定的

words.s: What I have in my hand is a fossil seashell.
words.sz: 在我手裡的是一個貝殼化石。
words.d: A fossil is the hard remains of a prehistoric animal or plant.

words.s: The gardener used her spade to make a hole for the new plant.
words.d: A spade is a tool used for digging.

words.s: I poked my finger on a thumb tack.
words.d: To poke something is to push something quickly with your finger or a pointed object.

words.s: The collision between the two cars created a loud noise.
words.d: A collision is the act of two things hitting into each another.

t: 制造， 制造业； 产品
words.s: The date of manufacture is shown on the lid.
words.sz: 生产日期在盖子上。
words.d: To manufacture something means to make it in a factory.

words.s: My sister is on a low-calorie diet for fitness training.
words.d: A calorie is a unit of heat used to measure how much energy a food will produce.

words.s: Even with all his wealth and fame, he's unhappy.
words.sz: 尽管有金钱和名誉，他还是不幸福。
words.d: Fame is a reputation one has gained among the public.

words.s: When I was a child, I used to swim in that pond.
words.sz: 当我还是个孩子的时候，我在这个泳池里游过泳。
words.d: A pond is a freshwater body that is smaller than a lake.

t: 牛排； 肉排； 鱼排
words.s: I thought you'd be full after eating that big steak.
words.sz: 我觉得吃完那块大牛排你就饱了。

words.s: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system.
words.sz: 水星是我們的太陽系中最小的行星。

t: 互相作用， 互相影响
words.s: The kids began to interact when the adults left the room.
words.d: To interact is to talk to or do something with another person.

t: 会员资格， 成员资格
words.s: I applied for membership in the association.
words.sz: 我申請成為協會會員。

t: 粉末； 【医】药粉 A；火药； 炸药
words.s: The table is covered with powder.
words.sz: 桌上布满了粉末。
words.d: Powder is a dry substance in the form of very small grains.

t: 错误， 过失； 误差
words.s: "There's an apostrophe missing. It's and its are different." "I know. It was a typing error."
words.sz: “你漏写了一个撇号。it's和its是有分别的。”“我知道。是我打错了。”

t: 网状物；广播网， 电视网；网络 A
words.s: Lesley is part of a volunteer network that plants trees in the city.
words.d: A network is a group of people or organizations that are in some way connected to each other.

t: 妒忌的；珍惜的， 爱惜的
words.s: You must not be jealous of others' success.
words.sz: 不要嫉妒其他人的成功。
words.d: A jealous person might take something from you.

words.s: A bicycle will rust if you leave it in the rain.
words.sz: 如果你把自行車留在雨中，它會生鏽的。
words.d: Rust is a red and brown coating on iron objects caused by water and air.

t: 伴随的， 随之而生的
服务员， 值班员； 护理人员
words.s: Tom is a flight attendant.
words.sz: 湯姆是空服員。

t: 痕迹， 踪迹；极少量， 微量
words.s: He disappeared without a trace.
words.sz: 他没有留下痕迹就消失了。
words.d: To trace something means to follow over it with the eyes or a finger.

words.s: Elaine got pneumonia after playing outside in the rain without a coat.
words.d: Pneumonia is a dangerous illness causing the lungs to fill with liquid.

t: 一系列， 大量； 排列
words.s: The toy cars are available in an array of colors.
words.d: An array is a large group or number of things.

t: 努力， 尽力； 力图
努力， 尽力； 力图
words.s: We will endeavour to finish the job by the end of the week.
words.sz: 我們會盡力在這禮拜結束前把工作完成。

t: 区别， 辨别 <；有差别地对待， 歧视
words.s: I don't discriminate.
words.sz: 我不歧视人。

t: 付还， 偿还；报答， 回报
words.s: I must repay the debt.
words.sz: 我得還債。
words.d: To repay is to pay back or to reward someone or something.

words.s: A strong monetary policy is important for a country to be successful.
words.d: When something is monetary, it relates to money.

words.s: A fire broke out at the inn where they were staying.
words.sz: 火警發生在他們住的旅館。
words.d: An inn is a place where travelers can rest and eat.

t: 履行， 执行；表演， 演出；性能， 特性
words.s: What time is the next performance?
words.sz: 下一場表演在幾點鐘？
words.d: Performance is how well someone or something functions, works, etc.

t: 连续的， 按顺序排列的
words.s: Tom had no idea that Mary was a serial killer.
words.sz: 汤姆不知道玛丽是个连环杀手。

words.s: The ambassador was recalled from Warsaw.
words.sz: 大使被从华沙召回。
words.d: An ambassador is a government worker who works in another country.

t: 生长； 增长； 发展
words.s: The third quarter GNP growth was 1% over the preceding quarter.
words.sz: 第三季國民生產總值較上一季成長了1％。

words.s: I found the comic book very interesting.
words.sz: 我發現這本漫畫書非常有趣。
words.d: When something is comic, it is funny.

words.s: We saw a woman weave a blanket on our vacation to South America.
words.d: To weave means to make cloth using horizontal and vertical threads.

t: 不明确的， 含糊的； 暧昧的
words.s: She had a vague feeling of guilt.
words.sz: 她隱約地有一種的內疚感。
words.d: If something is vague, it is not clear and gives very few details.

words.s: What's the round-trip fare?
words.sz: 往返票多少钱？
words.d: A fare is an amount of money paid to use a bus, train, or taxi.

words.s: Accuracy is important in arithmetic.
words.sz: 准确性在计算中很重要。

t: 精神病学；精神病治疗法
words.s: Studying psychiatry has taught me a lot about mental illness.
words.d: Psychiatry is the study and treatment of mental illness.

t: 坚决， 决心 A；决定， 决议
words.s: My New Year's resolution is to learn how to play the ocarina.
words.sz: 我新年的願望是學會吹奧卡利納塤。
words.d: A resolution is a personal decision.

words.s: I live in a home with my spouse and our two children.
words.d: A spouse is the person to whom someone is married.

t: 落山；底座；环境； 背景
得分， 分数；二十 A <
words.s: He got a better score than us.
words.sz: 他得到了比我们还高的分数。

words.s: His writing was full of quotes from Shakespeare.
words.d: A quote is what someone has said, including saying how much a piece of work will cost.

words.s: Tom will graduate from high school the year after next.
words.sz: 湯姆將在後年高中畢業。
words.d: To graduate from a school means to complete and pass all courses of study there.

t: 定额， 限额， 配额
全体一致的， 一致同意的
words.s: The election was unanimous.
words.sz: 选举一致通过了。

t: 热的， 由热造成的；保暖的

words.s: The criminal was scorned by everyone in the community.
words.d: To scorn someone means to behave without respect toward them.

words.s: Sulfur burns with a blue flame.
words.sz: 硫磺燃燒著藍色的火焰。

words.s: Please use a rag to clean the dust off the table.
words.d: A rag is a small towel.

t: 悲伤， 悲痛；悲伤的事； 悲痛的缘由
words.s: The grief caused by losing her parents was very difficult for her.
words.d: Grief is the feeling of deep sadness, usually when a person dies.

t: 羞耻的， 惭愧的， 害臊的
words.s: I'm very ashamed of myself about what I've done.
words.sz: 我對自己的作為很內疚。
words.d: Ashamed means feeling upset and embarrassed because of a bad action.

t: 敲击， 急敲；责备， 训斥
敲击， 急敲；说唱音乐
words.s: Do you like rap?
words.sz: 你喜欢说唱音乐吗？

t: 未必的； 不可能的； 靠不住的
words.s: I know that it is highly unlikely that anyone would be willing to help me.
words.sz: 我知道不太可能有人願意幫助我。

words.s: A cornered rat will bite a cat.
words.sz: 窮鼠囓狸。

t: 笔迹， 手迹， 书法
words.s: Do you know whose handwriting this is?
words.sz: 你知道这是谁的字吗？

t: 未煮过的， 生的；未加工过的；未经训练的
words.s: Japan imports various raw materials from abroad.
words.sz: 日本從國外進口各種原料。
words.d: A raw material is natural and has not been processed.

words.s: I'll sauté a few sweet potatoes and sprinkle them with sugar.
words.sz: 我去炸一點紅薯，然後在上面撒上糖。
words.d: To sprinkle means to scatter something all over something else.

words.s: During the summer, the courtyard is a nice place to have lunch.
words.d: A courtyard is an outdoor area that is surrounded by the walls of a building.

words.s: His nationality is German, but he speaks French, Spanish, and Korean.
words.d: Nationality is an identity based on the nation from which you come.

t: 市的， 市政的， 市立的
words.s: The municipal parking lot downtown can fit one hundred cars.
words.d: Municipal means that something belongs to a city or local government.

t: 设立， 设置， 制定
学会， 研究所， 学院
words.s: I am going to a lecture about Ancient Rome at the Historical Institute.
words.d: An institute is an organization that is interested in research or teaching.

t: 忍受， 容忍 <；持久， 持续
words.s: Can she endure a long trip?
words.sz: 她能忍受長途旅行嗎？
words.d: To endure means to experience and survive something difficult.

t: 招贴， 海报， 广告
words.s: He paused to look at the poster.
words.sz: 他停下脚步看起海报。

words.s: She had to accept her fate.
words.sz: 她该接受她的命运。
words.d: Fate is a power that causes things to happen.

words.s: I've had a scratchy throat since this morning. I wonder if I've caught a cold.
words.sz: 早上起来，嗓子变得很沙哑，我想是不是感冒了。

words.s: The essence of the argument was that both sides felt they had lost money.
words.d: The essence of something is its important qualities or basic characteristics.

t: 手的； 手工做的； 体力的
words.s: Can you drive a manual transmission?
words.sz: 你會開手排車嗎?

t: 演习；谨慎地运用技巧移动， 运动；熟练而巧妙地引导某人
词汇， 词汇量 A；词汇表
words.s: You need a large vocabulary to read that book.
words.sz: 你讀那本書需要大量詞彙。

t: 退休， 引退 <；退却， 撤退；就寝
words.s: I hope to retire from work when I'm 60 years old.
words.sz: 我希望在六十歲時退休。
words.d: To retire is to leave a job, usually because of old age.

t: 样子， 外表， 面貌；方面
words.s: Imagination affects every aspect of our lives.
words.sz: 想像力影响着我们生活的各个方面。
words.d: An aspect is one part or feature of something.

words.s: Tom's new girlfriend is a vegetarian.
words.sz: 汤姆新的女朋友是素食主义者。
words.d: A vegetarian is someone who does not eat any meat products.

t: 侵略的， 好斗的 <；敢作敢为的， 有进取心的； 积极的 A；强有力的
words.s: He is an aggressive person.
words.sz: 他是个咄咄逼人的的人。
words.d: If someone is aggressive, then they constantly want to fight or argue.

t: 分期付款， 分期交付；一集； 一期

words.s: A red octagon is used to signify a place to stop.
words.d: To signify means to be a symbol of something.

t: 迫使； 责成；感激， 施恩于
words.s: If I wanted to have playtime, I was obliged to clean my room once a week.
words.d: To oblige someone means to require them to do something.

t: 摇摆， 摇荡；回转， 旋转
words.s: He can swing a golf club very powerfully.
words.d: To swing something means to move it back and forth or from side to side.

t: 吵闹的； 狂暴的； 汹涌的；动乱的， 无秩序的

words.s: In Korea, walls were built around cities to protect them from invasions.
words.d: An invasion is an attack by a group from another country.

t: 先例， 范例； 惯例
words.s: He set a precedent.
words.sz: 他開了先河。

t: 旋转；纺纱；织网， 吐丝
words.s: The boy kept spinning until he fell down.
words.d: To spin is to turn around in circles.

words.s: The kids were playing in the shallow water.
words.d: A shallow thing is not deep.

words.s: He emerged from the pool and spit water from his mouth.
words.d: To spit means to force liquid from one’s mouth.

t: 注册， 登记 <；指示； 自动记下；把挂号
words.s: Could you please sign the register?
words.sz: 請您在登記冊上簽名好嗎？
words.d: A register is an official list or record of people or things.

t: 得不到休息的；不平静的；不安的， 坐立不安的
words.s: I've been feeling a little restless.
words.sz: 我有點不安。

words.s: The fleet of ships spent a few days at the dock.
words.d: A fleet is a group of ships.

words.s: Language is the means by which people communicate with others.
words.sz: 语言是人们与他人交流的手段。
words.d: When we communicate with others, we talk or write to them.

t: 鞍； 马鞍； 鞍状物

words.s: I want to live in a small house in a rural area.
words.d: If a place is rural, it is in the countryside instead of the city.

words.s: Acid rain is not a natural phenomenon.
words.sz: 酸雨不是自然现象。
words.d: An acid is a chemical that can burn or dissolve other substances.

t: 播送； 发射；传动， 传送
words.s: Can you drive a manual transmission?
words.sz: 你會開手排車嗎?

words.s: The recent shortage of coffee has given rise to a lot of problems.
words.sz: 近来咖啡的短缺造成了许多问题。
words.d: Shortage comes from short and means not having enough.

t: 使人厌倦的； 讨厌的
有问题的， 靠不住的；半信半疑的， 可疑的；结果未定的， 不能确定的
words.s: The police thought that the man’s description of the crime was dubious.
words.d: When something or someone is dubious, they are not considered honest.

words.s: Life is short and time is swift.
words.sz: 人生苦短，岁月如梭。
words.d: A swift person or animal is fast.

t: 造成； 提出， 陈述
words.s: When you pose a question, you expect an answer.
words.sz: 當你提出一個問題，你期望得到答案。
words.d: To pose is to stay in one place without moving.

words.s: The countries were in agreement that the treaty needed to be amended.
words.d: To amend something means to change it to improve or make it accurate.

words.s: The volcano erupted for the first time in ten years.

words.sz: 在危險的時候你必須跟你的老師聯繫。

words.d: A germ is a very small living thing that can make people sick.

t: 使…粉碎； 使散开；使破灭； 使震惊
words.s: When the ball hit the window, the glass shattered.
words.d: To shatter something means to break it suddenly into many tiny pieces.

words.s: The young woman showed of her glamour during the photo shoot.
words.d: Glamour is a quality relating to riches, wealth, and beauty.

words.s: "A rolling stone gathers no moss" is a proverb.
words.sz: “滚石不生苔”是一句谚语。

t: 一瞥； 一看； 短暂的感受
words.s: I caught a glimpse of Mt. Fuji from the window of the train.
words.sz: 我從火車車窗瞥見了富士山。
words.d: To glimpse something is to see it for a short time.

words.s: She employed a private detective to keep a watch on her husband.
words.sz: 她僱了一個私人偵探看守她的丈夫。

t: 换车；转业， 转学；调动， 转职
words.s: We will make the payment by bank transfer.
words.sz: 我们会用银行转帐付款。
words.d: To transfer something means to move it from one place to another.

words.s: Tom is a Vietnam veteran.
words.sz: 汤姆是一个越军退役军人。
words.d: A veteran is someone who has a lot of experience doing something.

t: 短语， 词语， 习语

words.sz: 這個片語是什麼意思？

words.sz: 人人都知道他對那狗的感情。
words.d: Affection is a feeling of liking someone or something.

words.s: She had the nerve to speak out.
words.sz: 她竟敢說出來。

t: 省略， 删去；遗漏， 忽略 <
words.s: What did I omit?
words.sz: 我省略了什麼？
words.d: When you omit something, you leave it out or do not do it.

words.s: The child held the erroneous belief that time machines were real.
words.d: When something is erroneous, it is incorrect or only partly correct.

t: 发起人； 主办者； 保证人

words.s: He jogs every day so he can be healthier.
words.d: To jog is to run slowly.

words.s: He inserted an extra sentence into the story.
words.d: To insert something means to put it in something else.

words.s: After Robert used his crayons on the wall, his mother wanted to forbid him from using them at all!
words.d: To forbid means to order someone not to do something.

words.s: After climbing Mt. Fuji, I got the inspiration for a poem.
words.sz: 攀登富士山後，我得到了一首詩的靈感。

t: 使显著， 使突出； 强调
最精彩的部分； 最重要的事件
words.s: I read my vocabulary list and highlighted the most difficult words.
words.d: To highlight something means to mark it with a color so that it is easy to see.

words.s: The company has a database of all the names and accounts of their customers.
words.d: A database is a collection of data that is stored in a computer.

t: 拒绝； 抵制； 驳回；丢弃；排斥； 退掉
words.s: I’m afraid the teacher will reject my new idea.
words.d: To reject is to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

t: 纯粹的； 十足的， 全然的；陡峭的， 险峻的
words.s: It is a sheer waste of time.
words.sz: 這完全是浪費時間。
words.d: If you describe something as sheer, it is complete and total.

t: 奇迹， 令人惊奇的人
words.s: I can hope for a miracle, can't I?
words.sz: 我能等奇跡發生，是不是？
words.d: A miracle is an unexpected blessing which seems almost impossible, like a gift from heaven.

words.s: I'll take that as a compliment.
words.sz: 我就当你夸我了。
words.d: To compliment is to say a nice thing about someone or something.

t: 模仿， 仿效；仿制； 仿造品
words.s: That's an imitation.
words.sz: 那是一個仿造品。

t: 得利， 获益； 利用； 有利于
words.s: I made a small profit from selling my old clothes.
words.d: A profit is the extra money you make when you sell something.

words.s: A considerable amount of time and effort have been spent already.
words.sz: 已經花費了很多的時間和精力。
words.d: An amount is how much there is of something.

t: 照做， 遵照， 应允
最初的， 原始的； 原文的 <；新颖的， 有独创性的
原物； 原作； 原文
words.s: Tom makes his own original Christmas cards every year.
words.sz: 湯姆每年都會製作自己獨創的聖誕節賀卡。
words.d: If something is original, it is the first one of that thing.

words.s: Very few deviate much from the average.
words.d: To deviate is to move away from your proper course.

t: 粘贴簿； 集邮簿； 相册
words.s: He showed me his photograph album.
words.sz: 他給我看了他的影集。

t: 分配， 委派； 任务；作业
words.s: The assignment took me longer than I had expected.
words.sz: 我用了比我预期更长的时间来完成作业。
words.d: An assignment is task that is given to you to do.

words.s: Cover your mouth when you cough, sneeze, or yawn.
words.sz: 你咳嗽、打喷嚏或打哈欠的时候要捂住你的嘴。
words.d: To yawn means to open one’s mouth wide and breathe in air.

words.s: Outside the school, she saw people with no homes living in cardboard boxes.
words.sz: 她在校外見到沒家的人住紙板箱。

words.s: UK is the abbreviation for the United Kingdom.
words.sz: UK是英国的缩写。

words.s: I'm afraid that I differ with you on this point.
words.sz: 恐怕就这点上，我和你持不同意见。
words.d: To differ is to not be the same as another person or thing.

words.s: I always find puppet shows a bit creepy.
words.sz: 我总觉得木偶戏有点吓人。

words.s: In the latter minutes of the game, the visitors scored the winning goal.
words.d: Latter describes something last in a series or the second choice of two things.

t: 相等的， 等价的， 等值的 <
相等物， 等价物， 等值物； 对应词
words.s: The ages of the two children put together was equivalent to that of their father.
words.sz: 两个孩子的年龄加起来和他们的父亲相当。
words.d: An equivalent is an amount or value that is the same as another amount or value.

words.s: We went down a river by canoe.
words.sz: 我們乘著獨木舟向河的下游而行。
words.d: A canoe is a long, light boat with pointed ends.

瘟疫； 祸患， 灾害
words.s: A plague in Europe killed millions of people.
words.d: A plague is a serious disease that quickly spreads to many people.

t: 永久的， 永恒的； 长期的 A
取缔， 查禁； 禁止
words.s: We should ban advertising aimed towards children.
words.sz: 我们应该禁止针对儿童的广告。
words.d: To ban something is to not let people do it.

words.s: Slavic languages fascinate me.
words.sz: 斯拉夫语让我着迷。
words.d: To fascinate someone is to make that person very interested.

t: 外交的， 从事外交的；有策略的， 有手腕的
words.s: There must be a way to arrive at a diplomatic solution.
words.sz: 必须有外交解决的途径。

t: 遭受； 忍受， 忍耐 <
words.s: I can't bear to see animals suffer.
words.sz: 我无法忍受看着动物受苦。
words.d: To suffer is to feel pain.

words.sz: 如果你唱歌了，他们就会把你踢出酒吧。

放映机， 幻灯机， 投影仪

草稿， 草案， 草图
words.s: I am writing a draft of the speech.
words.sz: 我在寫演講的草稿。
words.d: A draft is a piece of written work that is not in its final form.

t: 复杂的；合成的， 综合的
words.s: Do you know anything about complex carbohydrates?
words.sz: 你对复合碳水化合物有什么了解吗？
words.d: If something is complex, it has many small parts. It is hard to understand.

words.s: Boris was a famous ballet dancer because people admired his fluid movements.
words.d: If something is fluid, it is smooth and moves gracefully.

words.s: We were granted the privilege of fishing in this bay.
words.sz: 我们得到了在这个海湾内捕鱼的特权。
words.d: A bay is an area near the ocean where the land goes inward.

words.s: This pamphlet is free of charge.
words.sz: 這本小冊子是免費的。

words.s: Keep your eyes wide open before marriage, half shut afterwards.
words.sz: 婚前張開眼，婚後半閉眼。

words.s: Eating healthily keeps your arteries clean so blood can flow with ease.
words.d: An artery is a tube that takes blood from the heart to the rest of the body.

words.s: Don't underestimate your own strength.
words.sz: 不要低估自己的实力。

t: 塑料的， 塑胶的；可塑的， 塑性的

words.sz: 塑料盘子在烤箱里会化的。
words.d: Plastic is a material made by people.

t: 球体， 地球仪；地球， 世界

words.sz: 赤道把地球分为两个半球。
words.d: The globe refers to the Earth.

words.s: At the end of his speech, everyone burst into loud applause.
words.d: Applause is the noise made when people clap their hands to show approval.

t: 教长； 主持牧师 A；学院院长； 系主任； 训导主任

words.s: A sponge absorbs water.
words.sz: 海绵吸水。

words.s: The mean man abused his dog when it barked too loudly.
words.d: To abuse means to hurt someone or something on purpose.

t: 隔离， 孤立；使绝缘， 使绝热
words.s: People can conserve energy by insulating their houses.
words.d: To insulate something means to protect it from heat, cold, or noise.

t: 计划， 策划； 阴谋
计划， 方案； 阴谋；配置； 安排

words.d: A scheme is a plan or design.

words.s: Other people's expectations affect how we behave.
words.sz: 其他人的期望會影響我們的行為。
words.d: To affect someone or something is to have an influence over them.

words.s: Kindness is the language which the deaf can hear and the blind can see.
words.sz: 善良是聾子能聽盲人能看的語言。
words.d: A deaf person or animal cannot hear.

t: 排水沟， 阴沟；流出； 消耗
words.s: .The water in the sink goes down the drain as you wash your hands.
words.d: A drain is a pipe that carries away water from a building, such as in a kitchen

words.s: The singer was very good. She amused the crowd.
words.d: To amuse someone means to do something that is funny or entertaining.

words.s: The teacher isolated the bad child from the class before talking with her.
words.d: To isolate is to separate one person or thing from a group.

t: 在内的， 里面的； 内心的 <
words.s: She had an inward feeling of guilt when she lied to her mother.
words.d: If a thought or feeling is inward, it is not expressed or shown to others.

t: 责任， 责任心；职责， 任务
words.s: I take full responsibility for the action.
words.sz: 我會為這次行動負起全責。
words.d: Responsibility is a task or duty that you are expected or required to do.

words.sz: 要不是当初有内战，他们现在应该挺富裕了。

words.d: If something is subsequent, then it comes after something else in time.

words.sz: 微笑並不一定表示高興。
words.d: When we indicate something, we show or point out our thoughts or plans.

words.sz: 自來水有可能含有氯、鉛等有害物質。
words.d: To contain is to hold or have something.

words.s: Did you sew this by hand?
words.sz: 是用手縫的嗎？
words.d: To sew means to put pieces of cloth together using string or thread.

t: 圆柱， 柱状物；列； 专栏
words.s: I found this column interesting.
words.sz: 我發現這個專欄很有趣。

words.s: We read a biography about Charles Darwin in science class.
words.d: A biography is an account of someone’s life that is written by someone else.

t: 程序， 手续， 步骤

words.sz: 你不明白流程。

words.sz: 样本不够纯净。

words.s: The ozone in the stratosphere absorbs ultraviolet radiation.
words.sz: 平流層的臭氧會吸收紫外線。

words.s: We were disappointed to hear that Tom couldn't get a visa.
words.sz: 我们很遗憾地听说，汤姆没能拿到签证。

words.s: Several of the children were diagnosed with the flu.
words.d: To diagnose someone means to identify the medical condition they have.

words.d: A petition is a written request asking an authority to do something.

words.sz: 湯姆、瑪麗、約翰和愛麗絲都顯得有些驚訝。
words.d: Somewhat means to some degree, but not to a large degree.

words.s: The child was very earnest when she told her mother how she broke the dish.
words.d: If someone is earnest, then they are honest.

t: 大罐， 壶；一大罐的容量

words.s: Some adults have a fear of little creatures such as spiders.
words.d: A spider is a small creature with eight legs.

t: 领先， 在…之前； 优先， 先于 A

words.d: To precede something means to come before it.

words.d: A deck is a wooden floor built outside of a house or the floor of a ship.

t: 散步； 溜达； 闲逛

words.d: To stroll means to walk slowly and calmly.

words.s: Even though I enjoy bowling, I haven't gone bowling recently.
words.sz: 虽然我享受打保龄球，但是我最近没有去打保龄球。

words.s: It was hard to differentiate between the identical twins.
words.d: To differentiate things or people is to show the difference between them.

t: 接触， 联系， 交往
接触， 联系， 交往

words.sz: 我们联系上他们已经为时已晚。
words.d: To contact people is to speak or write to them.

t: 发射； 排出， 流出； 放

t: 未来的， 预期的； 可能的
灰泥； 熟石膏； 膏药 <
words.s: He used plaster to fill in the cracks in the old walls.
words.d: Plaster is a smooth paste that gets hard when it dries.

t: 成长的； 成熟的； 成人的

words.s: After years of living on a farm, Rufu was finally moving to a metropolitan area.
words.d: If something is metropolitan, it relates to a large city.

words.s: Don't forget to take out the garbage.
words.sz: 别忘了把垃圾拿出去。
words.d: Garbage is waste material like unwanted or spoiled food, bottles, paper, etc.

t: 可疑的； 多疑的， 疑心的

words.sz: 这种说法其实有点可疑。
words.d: A suspicious person does not trust others, or is not trusted by others.

words.s: He does nothing but complain from morning till night.
words.sz: 他从早到晚只是在抱怨。
words.d: When you complain, you say that you are unhappy about something.

t: 挂念； 焦虑， 忧虑 A；渴望， 热望
words.s: When I have to climb to high places, I’m filled with anxiety.
words.d: Anxiety is a feeling of worry and fear.

words.s: The old fire station was renovated into an apartment building.
words.d: To renovate a building means to repair it, or to build new structures on it.

t: 调节， 调整 <；校正， 校准 <
words.s: Our eyes take time to adjust to the darkness.
words.sz: 我们的眼睛需要时间来适应黑暗。
words.d: To adjust something means to change it so it is better.

t: 有力的； 朝气蓬勃的， 精力旺盛的
words.s: Henry uses vigorous exercise to keep himself in shape.
words.d: If something or someone is vigorous, they use a lot of energy.

words.s: All you have to do is ask him to pay the debt.
words.sz: 你只需要喊他还债就行。
words.d: A debt is an amount of money that a person owes.

words.s: I deemed the ice cream to be very delicious.
words.d: To deem means to consider something.

words.s: Traffic signs compel drivers to drive safely.
words.d: To compel someone to do something means to force them to do it.

words.s: This airplane is capable of carrying 40 passengers at a time.
words.sz: 这架飞机一次可以携带40名乘客。
words.d: A capable person or thing can do an action.

t: 压抑； 降低； 削弱；使沮丧， 使抑郁
words.s: The bad news from work depressed the man.
words.d: To depress someone is to make that person sad.

words.s: A crowd of people gathered to see the parade.
words.sz: 一大群人聚在一起看巡游。
words.d: A parade is a series of things or people that come or are shown one after another.

words.s: I could not answer Wendy’s riddle, but it made me laugh.
words.d: A riddle is a question that is difficult to answer but meant to be funny.

t: 敬礼； 向…致敬； 问候

讨论会， 专题报告会；专题论文集

words.s: Bring me a glass of tea with lemon.
words.sz: 給我泡杯檸檬茶。

words.s: The players awaited the referee’s decision.
words.d: To await something means to wait for it.

t: 顾客；委托人， 当事人
words.s: She has many clients who enjoy coming to her salon.
words.d: A client is a person or business that pays another to do a service.

words.s: Is it always a sin to tell a lie?
words.sz: 说谎总是一种罪吗？
words.d: A sin is something that is wrong for religious reasons.

t: 啜饮， 抿， 呷 A

words.s: The artist took a lump of clay and turned it into a beautiful pot.
words.d: A lump is a small piece of something that is solid.

words.s: The city discussed the conversion of the parking lot into a skateboard park.
words.d: Conversion is the act of changing something into a different state or form.

t: 投票选举， 无记名投票
投票表决； 无记名投票；选票
光辉的， 灿烂的；卓越的， 有才华的
words.s: A brilliant future lay before him.
words.sz: 大好的前途摆在他面前。
words.d: A brilliant person is very bright or smart.

words.s: Mary tied an apron around her waist and then took the turkey out of the oven.
words.sz: Mary试图把围裙围在腰上，然后把烤鸡从炉子里拿出来。

t: 受约束的； 有义务的；注定的， 肯定的；准备到…去的， 开往…的
words.s: We are bound to each other by a close friendship.
words.sz: 友谊紧紧联系着我们。

words.s: We hung a Christmas wreath on the front door.
words.sz: 我們在前門上掛了一個聖誕花圈。

t: 击， 敲； 报时的钟声 A；一击， 一划， 一笔；一次努力；中风
words.s: Tom had a heat stroke.
words.sz: 汤姆中暑了。
words.d: A stroke is a single movement of a pen or brush when you are writing or painting.

t: 造成， 引起；教养， 抚养；饲养
words.s: I like small dog breeds, such as terriers.
words.d: A breed is a group of animals within a species.

words.s: He was not very active in the realm of business.
words.d: A realm is any area of activity or interest.

t: 避免； 回避， 逃避 A
words.s: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
words.sz: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
words.d: To avoid something is to stay away from it.

words.s: How much did you bid?
words.sz: 你出價多少？
words.d: A bid to do something is an attempt to do it.

words.s: Always do right. This will gratify some people and astonish the rest.
words.sz: 坚持做对的事情。这会满足一部分人同时使另一部分人感到惊讶。
words.d: To astonish someone means to greatly surprise them.

t: 敏捷的； 迅速的；即刻的
